claim: Related-deals sparkline subquery is missing AND precoBrl >= 30, so sub-threshold historical prices contaminate the sparkline chart.
evidence: disco/[slug]/page.tsx:270-276 — sparkline subquery queries HistoricoPreco with only a date filter, no price floor. Same omission at estilo/[slug]/page.tsx:131-138. Compare to queryDiscos.ts:184 and carousel.ts:86 which both have AND precoBrl >= 30.
runtimeTrigger: Any product with historical HistoricoPreco rows with precoBrl < 30 (pre-enforcement records) will show those low prices in sparklines on the related-deals section of disco pages and on estilo pages.

claim: Artist page computes precoAtual, media, and sparkline from raw Prisma precos with no precoBrl >= 30 filter and uses an all-time average instead of the 30-day rolling window used everywhere else, causing inconsistent discount display.
evidence: artista/[slug]/page.tsx:104-113 Prisma findMany fetches precos with only a date filter (capturadoEm >= oneYearAgo), no precoBrl floor. Lines 259-265: media = all-60-prices average, not 30-day. Lines 269-273: sparkline built without precoBrl >= 30 filter. queryDiscos.ts uses AVG(precoBrl) WHERE capturadoEm >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND precoBrl >= 30.
runtimeTrigger: Products with old sub-R$30 price records or products whose 30-day avg differs from all-time avg will show a different desconto on the artist page than on the main listing. If the most recent recorded price is < R$30, precoAtual shows that sub-threshold value.
